$comment: Manifest for the AI File Sorter integration. This file is the ONLY place
the pinned upstream identity is written; code reads it rather than
repeating the SHA. Verified against the upstream remote on 2026-09-08:
A pinned manifest does NOT make a running binary pinned. What the binary on
the owner's machine was built from is a separate question, answered at
runtime by discovery.py, which reports VERSION_UNVERIFIED when the binary
name: ai-file-sorter

protocol.$comment: Read from upstream app/lib/HeadlessAnalysisCommand.cpp and HeadlessStatusJson.cpp at the pinned SHA, not from the README.

settings.$comment: Upstream persists the model choice in its own INI (section 'Settings', key 'LLMChoice'). Bossman classifies that value itself; it does not reuse upstream's is_remote_choice(), which counts the 'Custom' endpoint as local.

boundaries.process_boundary: subprocess, typed argv, no shell string
